summary.en: Choose the first piece of each rod length, maximise revenue bottom-up, and recover all sold pieces.
summary.bn: প্রতি দৈর্ঘ্যে প্রথম টুকরা বেছে সর্বোচ্চ আয় ও কাটা টুকরাগুলো বের করো।

notes: The Rod Cutting implementations use C17 and the numeric limits stated in their input contracts.

practice.title: Best revenue while selling the whole length
practice.statementHtml: Read length n (0..16), then n prices (-99..99) for lengths 1..n. Print Enter length and prices:, then revenue = R. All rod material must be sold, even with negative prices.
hints: Zero is a base for empty length; it is not a valid default for every nonempty rod.

practice.title: Recover the cut lengths
practice.statementHtml: Read the same rod format and bounds. Print Enter length and prices:, revenue = R, then cuts: followed by the chosen piece lengths. Keep the smallest first cut on revenue ties.
hints: Each recovered cut reduces the remaining length by at least one.

practice.title: Rod Cutting: justify the decisions
practice.statementHtml: Explain why the recurrence or decision rule for Rod Cutting covers every valid candidate, and why evaluation terminates.
hints: All rod material must be sold in this model.
practice.answerHtml:
Any valid full sale of a positive-length rod contains a first piece of some length cut. Removing that piece leaves exactly length-cut material. If the remainder were sold for less than its optimal revenue, replacing that remainder plan would improve the whole sale. Therefore an optimum uses an optimal remainder for some considered first cut.

Each recurrence candidate is also feasible: sell one available-length piece and then a full optimal sale of the smaller remainder. Considering every first cut covers all partitions of the rod, even though different piece orders can describe the same partition. Taking the maximum chooses an attainable revenue at least as large as every full sale.

The empty base is correct. Induction over increasing length proves every revenue entry because all remainder lengths are smaller. The saved first cut belongs to an attaining candidate, so following it preserves the optimal revenue decomposition. Each cut is at least one, ensuring recovery terminates after at most n pieces.

This proof allows repeated piece lengths because the price list describes a sale option for any piece of that length, not a single inventory item. There is no item-prefix dimension preventing reuse. Compare that meaning with 0/1 knapsack, where each physical input record can be taken only once.

practice.title: Rod Cutting: derive resource bounds
practice.statementHtml: Derive the time and auxiliary-space bounds for the implementations of Rod Cutting. Separate input, working storage and returned information.
hints: Repeated piece lengths are allowed within the total material.
practice.answerHtml:
At length L, the loop tries L possible first cuts. Summing 1+2+...+n gives n(n+1)/2 trials and Θ(n²) time. The dp and first arrays use Θ(n) storage. Recovery takes Θ(number of pieces), at most O(n), and the printed plan has the same output-size bound.

A naive recursion that tries every first piece repeatedly solves the same remaining lengths. Its work grows exponentially without caching. Memoisation can evaluate each length once, giving the same quadratic candidate count as bottom-up tabulation, but adds recursive stack storage. The bottom-up routine makes dependency order visible and needs no recursive frames for evaluation.

Numeric bounds are separate from the number of states. With at most sixteen material units and each price between -99 and 99, any complete plan's revenue lies between -1584 and 1584. The sentinel -1000000 is safely below every attainable value. For general inputs, derive a suitable bound or initialise from the first valid candidate instead of guessing a universal sentinel.

quiz.prompt: What does the rod state dp[length] optimise?
options: Revenue while selling all that length
quiz.explanation: The contract requires all material to be used.

quiz.prompt: Which candidate represents leaving the rod uncut?
options: No candidate can leave it uncut
quiz.explanation: That choice adds its full price to dp[0].

quiz.prompt: Why can a zero default be wrong for positive lengths?
options: Zero is not representable in C
A rod always needs two cuts
All required-sale plans may have negative revenue
quiz.explanation: Zero would allow an empty sale that discards material.

quiz.prompt: Where is the price for a cut of length three stored?
quiz.explanation: The price array starts with the price for length one.

quiz.prompt: Why may the same piece length be chosen again?
options: Prices describe reusable length options, not single inventory items
Every physical item is duplicated automatically
The loop ignores the total length
quiz.explanation: Repeated pieces are allowed as long as their lengths sum to n.

options: Subtract the saved positive first-piece length
quiz.explanation: Positive piece lengths guarantee eventual remaining length zero.

quiz.prompt: How should a fixed physical cut fee be charged?
options: Once for every piece including the whole rod
Only for the final empty state
Only when a chosen first piece leaves a nonempty remainder
quiz.explanation: Selling the uncut remaining rod makes no saw cut.

quiz.prompt: What revenue does a length-four rod earn with prices 1,5,8,9?
What required-sale revenue comes from a length-one rod priced minus seven?
quiz.explanation: All material must be sold, so the answer may be negative.

quiz.prompt: What revenue belongs to the empty rod?
quiz.explanation: The base dp[0] is zero and no price is accessed.

keyPoints.en: All rod material must be sold in this model.
keyPoints.bn: এই মডেলে রডের সব অংশ বিক্রি করতে হবে।

keyPoints.en: A first piece leaves a shorter independent remainder.
keyPoints.bn: প্রথম টুকরা নিলে ছোট বাকি রডের সমস্যা থাকে।

keyPoints.en: The uncut rod is the candidate cut equal to length.
keyPoints.bn: cut পুরো দৈর্ঘ্যের সমান হলে রড না কাটার বিকল্প হয়।

keyPoints.en: Saved first-piece lengths recover the full sale.
keyPoints.bn: প্রথম টুকরার দৈর্ঘ্য রাখলে পুরো বিক্রির পরিকল্পনা পাওয়া যায়।

keyPoints.en: Negative prices require a nonempty-sale initial bound.
keyPoints.bn: ঋণাত্মক দাম হলে খালি বিক্রির শূন্য মান রাখা যাবে না।

keyPoints.en: Repeated piece lengths are allowed within the total material.
keyPoints.bn: মোট দৈর্ঘ্য মেনে একই মাপের টুকরা বারবার নেওয়া যায়।
